intro.title: Discover Kalniečių parkas
intro.description: Kalniečių parkas is a beloved urban park located in Kaunas, Lithuania's second-largest city. This green oasis provides residents and visitors with a peaceful retreat in the heart of the city. The park features walking paths, recreational areas, and beautiful landscaping that showcases Lithuania's natural beauty. It's a perfect destination for families, joggers, and anyone seeking relaxation in nature.

visitGuide.title: Visit Guide
items: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
Perfect for walking, jogging, and picnics.
Best visited during spring and summer for full greenery.

alsoKnownAs.title: Highlights

sections.title: Park Overview
sections.content: Kalniečių parkas is one of Kaunas's cherished green spaces, offering residents and tourists alike a place to escape the urban hustle. The park is well-maintained and features diverse vegetation, creating a habitat for local birds and small wildlife.

sections.title: Activities & Recreation
sections.content: The park provides excellent facilities for outdoor activities. Visitors can enjoy leisurely walks along paved paths, find quiet spots for reading or meditation, or simply relax on the grass. The park is also popular among fitness enthusiasts for morning jogst and outdoor exercises.

sections.title: Location & Access
sections.content: Conveniently located in Kaunas City Municipality, the park is easily accessible by public transportation or car. The address is Kaunas, 50119 Kaunas City Municipality, Lithuania. Plus Code: WWFX+HV. The park's central location makes it a popular destination for both locals and visitors.

sections.title: Natural Environment
sections.content: The park showcases Lithuania's natural beauty with its diverse tree species, well-maintained lawns, and seasonal flower displays. Throughout the year, the park offers changing scenery - from spring blossoms to autumn colors, making each visit unique and enjoyable.

reviews.title: Visitor Reviews
reviews.declaration: Visitor feedback can be viewed via Google Maps (external link).

items.name: Tomas J.
items.text: Beautiful park in the heart of Kaunas! Perfect for morning jogs and evening walks. Well-maintained paths and plenty of green space for everyone.

items.name: Lina S.
items.text: A wonderful green oasis in the city. Great for families with children. The park is clean, safe, and beautifully landscaped.

items.name: Mindaugas K.
items.text: Nice urban park with good walking paths. It's not very large but perfect for a quick escape from the city noise. Recommended for a peaceful afternoon.

items.name: Gabija L.
items.text: One of my favorite parks in Kaunas. Love the natural setting and the peaceful atmosphere. Great place to relax and reconnect with nature.

officialManagement.title: About Kalniečių parkas
officialManagement.text:
Kalniečių parkas is a public urban park managed and maintained by Kaunas City Municipality.
As one of Kaunas's green spaces, the park welcomes thousands of visitors each year. The park combines natural beauty with recreational facilities for the community.
